summary.what_it_does:
Later is a Mac menu bar app that saves your current workspace so you can close your windows and bring them back with one click. The page describes using it to save battery by closing windows on a trip and reopening them at your destination. It can also tidy up your desktop before screensharing in meetings. Users can schedule apps to reopen after a few minutes or several hours. The listing on awesome-mac describes it as open source and freeware.</what_it_does>
